  IN the attic        — chordoqda
  OUTSIDE the house   — uydan tashqarida

exercises.instructionEn: What is there in each room?
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir xonada nima bor? 'There is / There are' bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU UNITNING ASOSIY GRAMMATIKASI — 'there is' va 'there are':

  There IS a sofa in the living-room.       (BITTA narsa)
  There ARE some chairs in the dining-room. (KO'P narsa)

Qoida:
  • Birlik ot  → There is + A/AN + ot
  • Ko'plik ot → There are + SOME + ot(-s)

'some' — 'bir nechta' ma'nosida. Aniq soni muhim bo'lmaganda ishlatiladi.

DIQQAT — a yoki an?
  a sofa, a table, a fridge   (undosh tovush bilan boshlansa)
  an armchair                 (unli tovush bilan boshlansa)

O'zbekchada 'mehmonxonada divan bor' deymiz — gap XONA bilan boshlanadi.
Inglizchada esa gap 'There is...' bilan BOSHLANADI, xona OXIRIDA keladi.
Bu tuzilma o'zbek tilida yo'q, shuning uchun ko'p mashq qilish kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the adjectives in bold in the texts in Ex. 4 and fill in the nouns which are used with them.
exercises.instructionUz: 4-mashq matnlaridagi qalin sifatlarga qarang va ular bilan ishlatilgan otlarni yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SIFAT + OT birikmalari (collocations).

Ingliz tilida ba'zi sifatlar ma'lum otlar bilan ishlatiladi.
Masalan 'pretty' — kichik, nozik narsalar uchun: a pretty bedroom.
'Huge' esa juda katta narsalar uchun: a huge kitchen.

So'zni ALOHIDA emas, BIRIKMA holida yodlang — shunda tabiiy gapirasiz:
  ❌ 'beautiful' = chiroyli
  ✅ 'a beautiful garden' = chiroyli bog'

Matn A dan: lovely house, huge kitchen, spacious living-room,
            beautiful garden
Matn B dan: attractive flat, quiet street, pleasant area,
            pretty bedroom, modern kitchen, comfortable living-room,
            wonderful view, large garage

tasks.whyUz: A matni: 'a huge kitchen'. huge = ulkan.
A matni: 'a spacious living-room with a fireplace'. spacious = keng.

B matni: 'in a quiet street'. quiet = tinch.

B matni: 'a pretty bedroom'.
B matni: 'a modern kitchen'. modern = zamonaviy.
B matni: 'a comfortable living-room'. comfortable = qulay.
B matni: 'a wonderful view'. view = manzara.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the adjectives which have a similar meaning. Choose adjectives from the list above.
exercises.instructionUz: Yaqin ma'noli sifatlarni yozing. Yuqoridagi ro'yxatdan tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SINONIMLAR — bir xil ma'noli so'zlar.

Kitobda birinchi harf va harflar soni berilgan:
  big       = huge, s________, l_____
  beautiful = attractive, p______
  pleasant  = l______, w_________

Nega bir necha so'z kerak? Chunki bir so'zni takrorlab yozish
zerikarli. Yozma ishda sinonim ishlatish — yuqori daraja belgisi.

Ottenkalar:
  big      — oddiy 'katta'
  huge     — juda katta, ulkan
  large    — katta (big bilan deyarli bir xil, rasmiyroq)
  spacious — keng, joyi ko'p (xona uchun)

  beautiful  — go'zal (kuchli maqtov)
  attractive — jozibali
  pretty     — chiroyli (kichik narsalar uchun)

  pleasant  — yoqimli
  lovely    — yoqimli, shirin (og'zaki nutqda ko'p)
  wonderful — ajoyib (juda kuchli)

p bilan boshlanadi, 6 harf: pretty = chiroyli.

exercises.instructionUz: A matni — SOTILADIGAN uy. Har bir gapni o'qing va tarjimasini ko'ring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN A — gazetadagi ko'chmas mulk e'loni.

  For Sale £370,000
  Address: 11, Hawk's Lane, Canterbury

  For Sale — sotiladi
  Address  — manzil
  £        — funt sterling (Britaniya puli)

Manzil yozilishi INGLIZCHA tartibda:
  11, Hawk's Lane, Canterbury
  uy raqami, ko'cha nomi, shahar
O'zbekchada ham shunday tartib, lekin ingliz tilida uy raqami
HAR DOIM birinchi keladi va vergul bilan ajratiladi.

Canterbury — Angliyaning janubi-sharqidagi tarixiy shahar.

tasks.note: £370,000 o'qilishi: 'three hundred and seventy thousand pounds'.

tasks.en: This lovely house is half a mile from the city centre, and is near the shops and the main road.
tasks.uz: Bu go'zal uy shahar markazidan yarim mil masofada, do'konlar va katta yo'lga yaqin.
tasks.note: lovely = go'zal, yoqimli. half a mile ≈ 800 metr. 1 mile ≈ 1,6 km.

tasks.en: It is quite expensive, but it is very large.
tasks.uz: U ancha qimmat, lekin juda katta.
tasks.note: quite = ancha, but = lekin, very = juda.

tasks.en: Upstairs, there are three bedrooms, each with a wardrobe and a bathroom.
tasks.uz: Tepa qavatda uchta yotoqxona bor, har birida kiyim shkafi va hammom bor.
tasks.note: upstairs = tepa qavatda. each with... = har birida ... bilan.

tasks.en: There is also a study with a big bookcase.
tasks.uz: Yana katta kitob javonli ish xonasi ham bor.
tasks.note: also = ham, yana. 'There is' — birlik, bitta study.

tasks.en: Downstairs, there is a small bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a huge kitchen, a dining-room and a spacious living-room with a fireplace.
tasks.uz: Past qavatda dush va hojatxonali kichik hammom, juda katta oshxona, ovqatlanish xonasi va kaminli keng mehmonxona bor.

tasks.en: The house has also got a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.
tasks.uz: Uyning yana chiroyli bog'i va basseyni bor.
tasks.note: has got = bor (Britan inglizchasi). AQShda 'has' deyiladi.

tasks.en: It has got a pretty bedroom, a bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a modern kitchen with a cooker, a dishwasher and a fridge, and a comfortable living-room.

tasks.en: The flat has also got a big balcony with a wonderful view.
tasks.uz: Kvartirada yana ajoyib manzarali katta balkon bor.

tasks.en: There is a large garage behind the building.
tasks.note: large = katta (big bilan bir xil). behind = orqasida. building = bino.

exercises.instructionEn: How many rooms are there in each place? What is there in each room? What else has each place got?

Bu savollar matnni TUSHUNGANINGIZNI tekshiradi.

'How many...?' — nechta? Javob RAQAM bo'ladi.
'What else...?' — yana nima? Javob qo'shimcha narsa bo'ladi.

Sanashda faqat XONALARNI sanaymiz: bog', basseyn, balkon, garaj —
bular xona emas, ular 'outside' (tashqarida) hisoblanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the following, then complete the rules.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobdagi qoida:
  Most nouns take -s in the plural.
  Nouns ending in ................ take -es in the plural.

Jadvalga qarang: address, bus, brush, bench — ularning
oxirgi harflari qanday? Ana o'sha javob.

tasks.prompt: Nouns ending in ______ take -es in the plural.
tasks.promptUz: Qaysi harflar bilan tugagan otlar -es oladi?
tasks.whyUz: Jadvaldan: address (-ss), bus (-s), brush (-sh), bench (-ch). Bularga -x (box) va -o (tomato) ham qo'shiladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
Jadvaldagi 8 ta so'z + Unit 3 lug'atidan yana bir nechtasi.
Har birida -s yoki -es tanlashingiz kerak.

tasks.whyUz: oddiy -s
oddiy -s
oddiy -s
oddiy -s
-ss bilan tugaydi → -es
-s bilan tugaydi → -es
-sh bilan tugaydi → -es
-ch bilan tugaydi → -es
oddiy -s
-e bor, faqat -s qo'shiladi
oddiy -s
-sh bilan tugaydi → -es
-x bilan tugaydi → -es
-ch bilan tugaydi → -es

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida ko'plik OT OXIRIGA qo'shimcha qo'shib yasaladi.
O'zbekchada '-lar', inglizchada '-s' yoki '-es'.

Qaysi biri qo'shilishi otning OXIRGI HARFIGA bog'liq.

rules.enRule: Most nouns take -s in the plural.
Nouns ending in -ss, -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o take -es in the plural.

rule.noteUz:
NEGA -es? Chunki 's' tovushidan keyin yana 's' aytib bo'lmaydi.
  bus + s = 'bass' — eshitilmaydi
  bus + es = 'BAS-iz' — eshitiladi
Ya'ni -es qo'shimchasi TALAFFUZ uchun kerak. Uni /iz/ deb o'qiladi.
rule.extraUz:
TALAFFUZ 3 xil bo'ladi:
  /s/  — jarangsiz tovushdan keyin: books, cats, desks
  /z/  — jarangli tovushdan keyin: rooms, walls, chairs
  /iz/ — s, ss, sh, ch, x, ge dan keyin: buses, brushes, benches

Bu farqni yozuvda ko'rsatmaydi, lekin gapirishda muhim.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the following, then complete the rules.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobdagi qoida:
  We use this/these for things near us.
  We use ........./......... for things far from us.

tasks.prompt: We use ______ for things far from us.
tasks.promptUz: Uzoqdagi narsalar uchun qaysi juftlik ishlatiladi?
tasks.whyUz: FAR qatoridagi namunalar: 'That is a clock.' va 'Those are clocks.'

exercises.instructionEn: Write sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir raqamda IKKITA rasm bor: birinchisi YAQIN (this/these),
ikkinchisi UZOQ (that/those).

Namuna: This is a sofa and that is a table.

Qadam-qadam:
  1) Birinchi narsa bittami? → This is a ...
     Ko'pmi?              → These are ...
  2) Ikkinchi narsa bittami? → that is a ...
     Ko'pmi?               → those are ...

DIQQAT: gap o'rtasidagi 'that/those' KICHIK harf bilan yoziladi.
Va 'and' dan oldin vergul qo'yilmaydi.

tasks.answer: This is a desk and those are chairs.
tasks.promptUz: Bu yozuv stoli, ular esa stullar.

tasks.answer: This is a bench and those are lamps.
This is a mirror and those are towels.
This is a bookcase and that is a fireplace.
tasks.promptUz: Bu kitob javoni, u esa kamin.

tasks.answer: This is a cooker and that is a fridge.

rule.explanationUz:
To'rt so'z ikki narsani bir vaqtda ko'rsatadi:
  1) YAQINMI yoki UZOQMI?
  2) BITTAMI yoki KO'PMI?

              BITTA (singular)   KO'P (plural)
  YAQIN (near)   this              these
  UZOQ  (far)    that              those

O'zbekchada: bu / bular, u / ular — deyarli bir xil tizim.

rules.enRule: We use this/these for things near us.
We use that/those for things far from us.

rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — fe'lni unutish:
  ❌ This a chair.        ✅ This IS a chair.
  ❌ These is chairs.     ✅ These ARE chairs.

is/are ko'rsatish olmoshiga qarab tanlanadi:
  this / that  → IS
  these / those → ARE
rule.extraUz:
TALAFFUZ farqi:
  this  /ðɪs/  — qisqa 'i'
  these /ðiːz/ — cho'ziq 'ii' va oxirida 'z'
Ikkalasi juda o'xshash eshitiladi, shuning uchun ot ko'plikmi-yo'qmi
ekaniga qarab ham tushunish mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table, then complete the rules.
exercises.explanationUz: Kitobdagi to'ldirilishi kerak bo'lgan uchta qoida.

tasks.prompt: We use there ______ in the singular. (There ___ a bed in the bedroom.)
tasks.whyUz: There IS a bed in the bedroom. — bitta karavot, shuning uchun 'is'.

tasks.prompt: We use there ______ in the plural. (There ___ two beds in the bedroom.)
tasks.whyUz: There ARE two beds in the bedroom. — ikkita karavot, shuning uchun 'are'.

tasks.prompt: We use ______ in the plural in the negative and interrogative.
tasks.promptUz: Ko'plik inkor va savol gaplarda qaysi so'z ishlatiladi?
tasks.whyUz: There aren't ANY chairs. / Are there ANY chairs? — 'some' faqat tasdiq gapda.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete with there is / there are / there isn't / there aren't / some / any.
exercises.instructionUz: 'there is / there are' tuzilmasini mashq qiling.
exercises.explanationUz: Har bir gapda birlikmi-ko'plikmi, tasdiqmi-inkormi ekaniga qarang.

tasks.whyUz: birlik + tasdiq
ko'plik + tasdiq

tasks.prompt: There are ____ chairs in the kitchen. (tasdiq)
tasks.whyUz: ko'plik + tasdiq → some
tasks.speak: There are ____ chairs in the kitchen. (tasdiq)

tasks.prompt: There aren't ____ chairs in the kitchen. (inkor)
tasks.whyUz: ko'plik + inkor → any
tasks.speak: There aren't ____ chairs in the kitchen. (inkor)

tasks.prompt: ____ there any chairs in the kitchen? (savol, ko'plik)
tasks.whyUz: ko'plik savol → Are there ...?
tasks.speak: ____ there any chairs in the kitchen? (savol, ko'plik)

tasks.prompt: ____ there a bed in the bedroom? (savol, birlik)
tasks.whyUz: birlik savol → Is there ...?
tasks.speak: ____ there a bed in the bedroom? (savol, birlik)

tasks.prompt: Is there a bed in the bedroom? — Yes, ____ .
tasks.whyUz: birlik qisqa javob

tasks.prompt: Is there a bed in the bedroom? — No, ____ .
tasks.whyUz: birlik inkor qisqa javob

tasks.prompt: Are there any chairs in the kitchen? — Yes, ____ .
tasks.whyUz: ko'plik qisqa javob

tasks.prompt: Are there any chairs in the kitchen? — No, ____ .
tasks.whyUz: ko'plik inkor qisqa javob

rule.explanationUz:
Bu tuzilma 'BIROR JOYDA NIMADIR BOR' deyish uchun ishlatiladi.
'There' bu yerda 'u yerda' degani EMAS — u shunchaki gapni boshlash uchun
turadigan so'z. Tarjima qilinmaydi.

  There is a bed in the bedroom.  — Yotoqxonada karavot bor.
  (so'zma-so'z: 'bor bitta karavot yotoqxonada')

examples.q: Is there a bed in the bedroom?
Are there any chairs in the kitchen?

keyRules.enRule: We use there is in the singular.
examples: There is a bed in the bedroom.

keyRules.enRule: We use there are in the plural.
examples: There are two beds in the bedroom.

keyRules.enRule: We use some in the plural in the affirmative.
examples: There are some chairs in the kitchen.

keyRules.uzRule: Ko'plik + INKOR va SAVOL gapda — ANY.
keyRules.enRule: We use any in the plural in the negative and interrogative.
examples: There aren't any chairs in the kitchen.
Are there any chairs in the kitchen?

rule.warningUz:
SOME yoki ANY?
  ✅ There are SOME chairs.        (tasdiq)
  ✅ There aren't ANY chairs.      (inkor)
  ✅ Are there ANY chairs?         (savol)
  ❌ There aren't some chairs.
  ❌ Are there some chairs?

Oson eslash: 'some' — faqat TASDIQDA. Qolgan ikkisida 'any'.
rule.noteUz:
Qisqartmalar:
  there is not  = there isn't
  there are not = there aren't
Og'zaki nutqda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.

Savolda so'z tartibi ALMASHADI:
  There is a bed. → IS THERE a bed?
  There are beds. → ARE THERE any beds?

exercises.instructionEn: First read the sentences and explain the meaning of the words in bold, then listen and underline the correct word.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval gaplarni o'qing va qalin yozilgan so'zlarning ma'nosini tushuntiring, so'ng tinglab, to'g'ri so'zni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu mashq TINGLASHDAN OLDIN so'zlarni bilib olishga o'rgatadi.
Enterprise'da doim shunday: avval so'zlarni tushunasiz, keyin tinglaysiz.
Shunda audio tushunarli bo'ladi.

Bu yerdagi qarama-qarshi juftlar:
  expensive ↔ cheap   (qimmat ↔ arzon)
  big       ↔ small   (katta ↔ kichik)
  garage    ↔ garden  (garaj ↔ bog') — o'xshash yozilgan, chalkashtirmang!
  balcony   ↔ swimming-pool (balkon ↔ basseyn)

'quite' va 'rather' — 'ancha, birmuncha' ma'nosidagi kuchaytiruvchilar:
  The house is QUITE expensive.  — Uy ancha qimmat.
  The flat is RATHER small.      — Kvartira ancha kichik.
exercises.audioNoteUz: Kitobda bu yerda audio bor. Javoblarni 4-mashqdagi ikkita e'londan ham topish mumkin — shuning uchun bu mashqni audiosiz ham bajarsa bo'ladi.

tasks.whyUz: 4-mashqdagi A matnida: 'It is quite expensive, but it is very large.' Narxi £370,000 — qimmat. expensive = qimmat, cheap = arzon.
A matnida: 'Upstairs, there are three bedrooms.' upstairs = tepa qavatda, downstairs = past qavatda.

tasks.prompt: The house has also got a beautiful ____ .
tasks.whyUz: A matnida: 'a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.' garden = bog', garage = garaj. Ikkalasi o'xshash yoziladi, lekin ma'nosi butunlay boshqa.
B matnida: 'It is rather small, but it is in a very pleasant area.'

tasks.prompt: The flat has got a big ____ .
tasks.whyUz: B matnida: 'The flat has also got a big balcony with a wonderful view.' Basseyn (swimming-pool) uyda (A matni), kvartirada emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts again and make notes under the following headings, then look at the notes and talk about the two places. Type of Home - Location - Cost - Size - Inside the House/Flat (Rooms, Furniture etc) - Outside the House/Flat
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni qayta o'qing va sarlavhalar bo'yicha qayd yozing, so'ng qaydlarga qarab ikkala joy haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYD OLISH (making notes) — muhim ko'nikma.
Matnni to'liq yodlamaysiz, faqat KALIT so'zlarni yozib olasiz,
keyin o'sha qaydlarga qarab o'z so'zingiz bilan gapirasiz.

Sarlavhalar:
  Type of Home — uy turi (house / flat)
  Location     — joylashuvi (qayerda?)
  Cost         — narxi (qancha?)
  Size         — hajmi (katta / kichik)
  Inside       — ichkarisi (xonalar, mebel)
  Outside      — tashqarisi (bog', garaj, balkon)

Quyidagi namunalar — to'liq gap holida. Ularni yodlab olsangiz,
istalgan uy haqida gapira olasiz.

tasks.answer: The first place is a house.
It is at 11, Hawk's Lane, Canterbury, half a mile from the city centre.
It is for sale and it costs £370,000, so it is quite expensive.
Upstairs there are three bedrooms, each with a wardrobe, a bathroom and a study with a big bookcase.
Downstairs there is a small bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a huge kitchen, a dining-room and a spacious living-room with a fireplace.
Outside, the house has got a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.
The second place is a flat.
It is at 6, Shell Street, Canterbury, in a quiet street near the city centre.
It is for rent and it costs £180 a month, so it is very cheap.
It is rather small, but it is in a very pleasant area.
Inside, there is a pretty bedroom, a bathroom with a shower and a toilet, a modern kitchen with a cooker, a dishwasher and a fridge, and a comfortable living-room.
Outside, the flat has got a big balcony with a wonderful view and a large garage behind the building.

exercises.instructionEn: What things can you see in the picture below? Put a tick (✓) or a cross (✗) for each.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rasmda qaysi narsalarni ko'rasiz? Har biri uchun ✓ yoki ✗ qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Rasmda ovqatlanish xonasi tasvirlangan.
Kitob betini ochib rasmga qarang, so'ng har bir buyum bormi-yo'qmi belgilang.

Berilgan namunalar: dining-table ✓, armchair ✗, pictures ✓, posters ✗

tasks.whyUz: Stol ostida naqshli gilamcha yotibdi.
Bu ovqatlanish xonasi, divan mehmonxonada bo'ladi.
Stol atrofida bir nechta yog'och stul turibdi.
Shkaf ko'rinmaydi — u odatda oshxonada bo'ladi.
Stol ustida gulli guldon turibdi.
Devorda faqat rasmlar bor, oyna yo'q.
O'ng tomondagi derazada oq pardalar osilgan.
Karavot yotoqxonada bo'ladi, ovqatlanish xonasida emas.
Guldonda gullar bor.
Yostiq karavotda bo'ladi, bu yerda yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Talk about the room, as in the examples.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikkita buyumni BITTA gapda qarama-qarshi qo'yamiz:
  bor buyum + BUT + yo'q buyum

Namunalar:
  There is a dining-table but there isn't an armchair.
  There are some pictures but there aren't any posters.

DIQQAT — 4 ta shakl bir gapda:
  bor,  bitta  → There is a/an ...
  yo'q, bitta  → there isn't a/an ...
  bor,  ko'p   → There are some ...
  yo'q, ko'p   → there aren't any ...

Va 'an armchair' — 'a' emas, chunki 'armchair' unli tovush bilan boshlanadi.

tasks.answer: There is a rug but there isn't a sofa.
There are some chairs but there aren't any cupboards.
There is a vase but there isn't a mirror.
There are some curtains but there aren't any beds.
There are some flowers but there aren't any pillows.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Xona nomi ko'pincha 'nima uchun ishlatilishi' + room shaklida. Chiziqcha bilan yoziladi.
Jihoz nomlari ham qo'shma. Birinchi so'z QAYERDA yoki NIMA UCHUN ekanini aytadi.
Kundalik nutqda uzun so'zlar qisqaradi. Qisqasi ko'proq ishlatiladi.
Fe'l yoki otga -ive qo'shilib sifat yasaladi. Ma'nosi: 'shu xususiyatga ega'.
Otga -ful qo'shilsa 'shunga to'la' ma'nosidagi sifat chiqadi. DIQQAT: bitta 'l' bilan yoziladi!
Uy tavsifida doim juft bo'lib keladi.
Fe'l va ot bir xil yoziladi, lekin gapda vazifasi boshqa.
Bu tovushlardan keyin -s eshitilmaydi, shuning uchun -es qo'shiladi va /iz/ deb o'qiladi.
Bu so'zlar ham birlik/ko'plikka qarab o'zgaradi — ot kabi -s olmaydi, butunlay boshqa so'zga aylanadi.
not so'zi fe'lga qo'shilib qisqaradi. Apostrof (') tushib qolgan 'o' o'rnida turadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: There IS + a/an + BIRLIK ot + in the XONA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a sofa in the living-room.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
BITTA narsa uchun. 'a/an' SHART.
O'zbekchada gap joy bilan boshlanadi, inglizchada esa 'There is' bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: There ARE + some + KO'PLIK ot + in the XONA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are some chairs in the dining-room.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
KO'P narsa uchun. 'some' — aniq soni muhim bo'lmaganda.
Ot KO'PLIKDA: chairs, cupboards (chair emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: The XONA is ON the ground/first floor.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The kitchen is on the ground floor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Qavat uchun ON predlogi.
DIQQAT: 'ground floor' = o'zbekcha 1-qavat, 'first floor' = 2-qavat!

sentencePatterns.formula: The XONA is IN the attic. / OUTSIDE the house.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The study is in the attic. The garage is outside the house.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ish xonasi chordoqda. Garaj uydan tashqarida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Chordoq uchun IN (ichkarida), garaj uchun OUTSIDE (tashqarida).

sentencePatterns.formula: The house/flat HAS GOT + a/an + narsa.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The house has also got a beautiful garden and a swimming-pool.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uyning yana chiroyli bog'i va basseyni bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'have got / has got' — egalikni bildiradi (Britan inglizchasi).
  I/you/we/they HAVE GOT
  he/she/it     HAS GOT
Uy va kvartira — 'it', shuning uchun HAS GOT.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is quite expensive, but it is very large.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ancha qimmat, lekin juda katta.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kuchaytiruvchilar:
  quite  — ancha (o'rtacha)
  rather — ancha (ko'pincha salbiy: 'rather small' — kichikroq ekan)
  very   — juda (eng kuchli)

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Upstairs, there are three bedrooms. Downstairs, there is a huge kitchen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tepa qavatda uchta yotoqxona bor. Past qavatda ulkan oshxona bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Joy so'zi gap BOSHIDA turishi mumkin, keyin vergul qo'yiladi.
Bu tavsifni tartibli qiladi: avval tepa, keyin past.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: a bathroom with a shower and a toilet
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'with' — 'bilan, ...li'. Xona ichida nima borligini qisqa aytadi.
O'zbekchada '-li' qo'shimchasi: kaminli, dushli, javonli.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This lovely house is half a mile from the city centre.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu go'zal uy shahar markazidan yarim mil masofada.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Masofa uchun FROM. Yaqinlik uchun NEAR:
  near the shops = do'konlarga yaqin (from yo'q!)

sentencePatterns.formula: This is a ... and that is a ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is a sofa and that is a table.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikkala narsa ham BITTA. Yaqindagi — this, uzoqdagi — that.
Gap o'rtasida 'that' kichik harf bilan yoziladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is a ... and those are ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is a desk and those are chairs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yozuv stoli, ular esa stullar.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Birinchisi bitta (this is a), ikkinchisi ko'p (those are + ko'plik ot).
DIQQAT: ko'plikda 'a' QO'YILMAYDI — those are chairs (a chairs emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: There is a/an ... in the XONA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a bed in the bedroom.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are some ... in the XONA.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are some chairs in the kitchen.

sentencePatterns.formula: There isn't a/an ... / There aren't any ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There isn't an armchair. There aren't any posters.

sentencePatterns.formula: Is there a/an ...? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is there a bed in the bedroom? — Yes, there is.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savolda 'Is' oldinga chiqadi. Qisqa javobda 'a bed' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: Are there any ...? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are there any chairs in the kitchen? — No, there aren't.

sentencePatterns.formula: There is a ... BUT there isn't a ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a dining-table but there isn't an armchair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ovqat stoli bor, lekin kreslo yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' — 'lekin'. Ikki qarama-qarshi fikrni bitta gapga birlashtiradi.
